decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extension due to its coverage, size and scale, and cramped appearance would result in the over-development of the site with inadequate parking and servicing, which would be harmful to neighbouring residents' living conditions and the appearance of the site and the surrounding area.  This would be contrary to policies ENV.B.1.1 (All New Development), S.4.5 (Servicing Arrangements), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments), T.5.3 (Vehicle Crossovers and Hard standings), of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The proposed first floor part of the rear extension would, due to its position, size and scale, be harmful to the living conditions of residents at No. 311 Vicarage Farm Road, as it would result in the reduction of sunlight and daylight to the adjoining first floor window at the rear of this property.  This would be contrary to policy ENV.B.1.1 (All New Development) of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 3 - The external ducting due to its position, size, and appearance, would be harmful to the appearance of the premises and the surrounding area and to living conditions in the first flor flat. This would be contrary to policy ENV.B.1.1 (All New Development) of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 4 - The proposed restaurant would provide an insufficient entrance, which would not be fully accessible to all.  This would be contrary to policies ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities), S.4.2 (Shop Front Design), S.4.4 (Access to Shopping Facilities), and supplementary guidance 'Think Access', of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Change of use of ground floor to restaurant (A3), erection of part single storey and part two storey rear extension incorporating internal staircase to first floor flat, installation of new shopfront, and installation of fume extraction ducting to rear of the premises.
